data.name: RowTitle
data.comment: Title of the row in Settings, under Account, that opens the public page settings.

data.name: RowDetailUnknown
data.comment: Under the row when the app doesn't know yet whether the page is on.

data.name: RowDetailNeedsAccount
data.comment: Under the row when nobody is signed in.

data.name: PageTitle
data.comment: Browser tab title of the public page settings.

data.name: Heading
data.comment: Heading of the public page settings. Also the name of the link back from the lists of hidden plants and cuttings.

data.name: SignedOut
data.value: A public page needs an account, so the server can show it.

data.name: OffIntro
data.value: A page anyone can open, with the plants in this collection. Looking at it needs no account.

data.name: OffNoteHeading
data.value: Every plant becomes public unless you hide it.
data.comment: Bold line of the note shown before the page is turned on.

data.name: OffNoteText
data.value: New plants show up on it by themselves. You can hide any plant, cutting or photo afterwards.

data.name: NeverText
data.value: Rooms, prices, the shop or person a plant came from, tags, pots, care, notes, and plants that died or left.

data.name: Copy
data.comment: Button that copies the address of the page.

data.name: Open
data.comment: Link that opens the public page in a new tab.

data.name: AlsoOpensAt
data.comment: {0} is the long address of the page, which keeps working after it gets a name.

data.name: NameLabel
data.comment: Label of the field for the name.

data.name: NameHint
data.value: A name you give up can't be used again, by you or anyone, and its address stops working.

data.name: RemoveNameConfirm
data.value: Remove the name @{0}? A name you give up can't be used again, by you or anyone, and its address stops working.
data.comment: {0} is the name.

data.name: NameTooShort
data.comment: {0} is the fewest characters a name can have.

data.name: NameTooLong
data.comment: {0} is the most characters a name can have.

data.name: NameCharacters
data.value: Use only the letters a to z, digits and hyphens.

data.name: NameHyphens
data.value: A hyphen can't be first or last, or come twice in a row.

data.name: NameReserved
data.value: That name is reserved. Try another.

data.name: TitlePlaceholder
data.comment: Shown in the empty title field. The page uses the same words when no title is set.

data.name: LineLabel
data.comment: The sentence under the title.

data.name: LayoutShelvesHint
data.value: A row for each part, swiped sideways

data.name: LayoutPhotoWallHint
data.value: Photos edge to edge, names on them

data.name: ShowStoriesHint
data.value: Tapping a plant opens its photos and milestones. Notes are never shown.

data.name: ShowWishlistHint
data.value: Names only, never prices or where to find them

data.name: HiddenDetail
data.comment: {0} is how many show on the page, {1} how many are hidden from it.

data.name: SearchHint
data.value: Off unless you turn it on. Once your page is in search results, it can take weeks to drop out again after you turn this off.

data.name: TurnOffConfirm
data.value: The address stops working for good, and its name can't be used again. Turning it on again makes a new address.

data.name: ErrorBadRequest
data.value: The server didn't take that. Check the words and try again.

data.name: ErrorNotAllowed
data.value: Only someone who can edit this collection can change its public page.

data.name: ErrorNameTaken
data.value: That name is taken. Try another.

data.name: ErrorTooOften
data.value: You've changed this too often today. Try again tomorrow.

data.name: ErrorNotSetUp
data.value: Public pages aren't set up on the server yet.

data.name: ErrorOffline
data.value: Can't reach the server. Try again when you're online.

data.name: ItemsSync
data.value: Changes reach the page after the next sync.

data.name: ItemsSearch
data.comment: Label of the search field above the list of plants or cuttings the page could show.

data.name: ItemsEmptyPlants
data.value: No plants that the page can show yet.

data.name: ItemsEmptyCuttings
data.value: No cuttings that the page can show yet.

data.name: ShowOnPage
data.comment: Label of the switch on a row. {0} is the name of the plant or cutting.

data.name: PhotosHint
data.value: Tap a photo to hide it from the page or show it again.

data.name: PhotosNone
data.value: No photos to show or hide.

data.name: PhotoFrom
data.comment: {0} is the date the photo was taken.

data.name: OnYourPage
data.comment: Row in the Details of a plant or cutting, with a switch.
